chunks: The Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, said:
"The clouds are the sieve of the rain; were it not for that, it would spoil everything upon which it fell."

key_terms.السَّحَابُ: the clouds, which serve as the medium through which rain is regulated
key_terms.الْمَطَرِ: the rain that descends from the sky
key_terms.غِرْبَالُ: a sieve; something that filters or moderates
key_terms.لَأَفْسَدَ: it would have ruined or spoiled

ai.seo_question: How does Imam Ali عليه السلام describe the role of clouds in relation to rain?
ai.summary: Imam Ali عليه السلام describes the clouds as a divinely ordered means by which rain is moderated before reaching the earth. The saying points to the wisdom in creation and how natural processes protect living things from harm.
